title: Looks Nice, but It Leaks.
text: Looks Nice, but It Leaks.. I was tempted to give it two stars, because the kettle looks nice, but if you look closely at the photo, you'll notice the seam around the bottom where the pieces fit together.  Water leaks out from there.  Granted, it has leaked when I've left it overnight with water inside, and maybe Cuisinox would advise me to not do that, but let's be realistic.  Water gets left inside them overnight, at least on occasion, and it's a kettle for Pete's sake.  It can't hold water overnight?  I think the focus with this product was on the look, rather than on the functionality, and when manufacturers don't strike the right balance between the two, their products are destined for the trash bin.

product_metadata.title: Cuisinox 2.3 litres Whistling Kettle
description: This trendy kettle is durable enough to withstand the rigors of everyday stovetop use. Made of durable stainless steel in a two-toned finish with a 3-ply base. A polite whistle will indicate that the water has reached boiling point.
